item.title: @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.10.0
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: The runner also stops waiting for a confirmation of these calls and no longer yields them, including a denied call (`confirmation: 'deny'`) and a call to a tool that it does not own. Quote: * **api:** rename error data models, deprecating the old names Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/releases/tag/sdk-v1.10.0

item.title: @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.9.0
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: A host whose only `tar` or `unzip` is inside those directories can no longer download skills until one is installed outside. Quote: `rg`, and the `tar` and `unzip` that extract skills, no longer get the `ANTHROPIC_*` variables of the process, like the shell of `bash`. Quote: * **api:** deprecate old beta header values Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/releases/tag/sdk-v1.9.0
